GET /api/stocks; all warehouses, numeric stock IDs
semantics: Variant code is SKU/product mapping key, numeric stock ID is warehouse key. amount copied directly as reported onHand; available unknown/null. Whole nonnegative units only. paging: Page starts at 1, metadata/count consistency and duplicates checked, stable totals/page size required, <=1000 pages/stock, <=100000 rows total. Not a transactional snapshot.
errors: Nonempty errors array rejected even with HTTP 200. Upstream messages never logged. HTTP 401/403/429/5xx use existing controlled errors and Retry-After governor.
writes: Not implemented. Official movement write route is documented upstream, but no write requests or two-way support are exposed.
